name: Crypto 24/7 opening-range breakout: first N bars, volume-confirmed close break, midpoint stop, 2R target
author: piyushrav1 (delta-v01)
license: Source terms apply; paraphrased summary only
instruments_timeframes: Crypto futures, 5m candles default; window reset externally (reset_range).
entry_long: Opening range = first 3 bars of the window (e.g., 15m on 5m candles): range high/low/mid and average range volume. Long on the first completed candle that closes above range high with volume >= min_volume_x (1.0) x average range volume.
entry_short: First candle closing below range low with the same volume test.
exit: Stop at range midpoint; take profit at 2.0R of the risk distance.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Window start (what counts as "open" for 24/7 markets) is set by the caller via reset_range; adapted from day-trader-skill.
